segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Mark, thanks for calling back. I was starting to wonder if we missed each other on the renewal timing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, sorry about that, Dana. Honestly my whole morning got swallowed by admin work. I had to type yesterday's notes into the pipeline software, clean up a bunch of account fields that were blocking the quote, and assemble the deal desk packet before they'd approve the pricing. It ate like four hours that I expected to spend on customer calls, including yours, which is not great.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Well, we just need to know where the renewal lands. We have 42 seats today, and we're adding eight for the support team on September 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right. So 50 seats total, annual term, September 1 through August 31 next year. With the 7% renewal uplift and the added seats prorated into the new term, the quote is $54,600 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Last year was $48,900, so that tracks. Can you keep net 30 on the invoice?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 stays the same. No change to the service terms, and your current support package carries over.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We need the signed order form by August 16 so finance can cut the PO before month-end.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can send the order form this afternoon. If you return it by Friday, we should have the invoice issued the following Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it to me and cc procurement@northlakeparts.com.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll include the seat count, the September 1 start date, and the $54,600 total in the email.
